profile.symmetry: point_group_disabled; common zero checkpoint for all displaced directions
profile.force_stopping_rule: GPAW Forces: maximum all-atom force change <0.0001 eV/A over last two checked cycles

convention: V(u)-V(0)=K2*u^2/2+K4*u^4/4; one D displaced, other D and Pd fixed
operator_separation: LOCAL periodic-site column and local wells only; no primitive collective data consumed

coupling.column_scope: Actual all-atom responses to source x; not a full Hessian, source-y/z columns or extracted reciprocal bond kernel.
coupling.q0_definition: Kii-sum_neighbour(Jxx); H-only subspace, metals fixed, not all-ion acoustic zero
coupling.image_folding: Each distinct periodic H site counted once; response sums all images of the periodic source. Offsets label nearest-image distance shells, not unfolded infinite-lattice shells. Half-cell ties use numpy.rint (ties to even). Source diagonal also contains folded source-image terms; boundary images are not multiplied or divided.

100.least_squares: Fixed probe K2, joint energy and force; force rows scaled by max(u)=0.24 A, as analyse.py
100.k2_assumption: Cubic x=1 reference gives isotropic quadratic coefficient; finite +100 probe supplies both directions
100.inversion_assumption: Even local potential about the ideal centrosymmetric site; no negative SCF measurements added
100.residual_convention: fitted minus measured; forces projected along the displacement unit vector
